images.filename: World's Tallest Totem Pole, Victoria, British Columbia.JPG
images.caption:
The "World's Second Tallest Totem_Pole ", (127 ft, 7 inches) located in Victoria, British Columbia. Note that other totem poles are also claimed to be the world's tallest, when picking a name, truth does not need to be the first thought on one's mind. The tallest totem in the world is located in Alert Bay BC!!

Carved by Mungo Martin, David Martin, and Henry Hunt. Dedicated 2 July, 1954.

images.caption:
Craigdarroch was built between 1887-1890 for Robert Dunsmuir, a Scottish immigrant who made his fortune from Vancouver Island coal. This legendary Victorian mansion, built on a hill overlooking the City of Victoria (Craigdarroch means "rocky, oak place" in Gaelic) announced to the world that Robert Dunsmuir was the richest and most important man in Western Canada.

Craigdarroch Castle
